mapper.sql: m.id, m.member_email, m.member_phone, m.member_password, m.member_name, m.member_alias, m.member_status::text as member_status, a.member_role::text as member_role, a.member_type::text as member_type
mapper.select: select from tbl_member m left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where lower(m.member_email) = #{email}
select from tbl_member m left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where m.member_phone = #{phone}
select from tbl_member m left join tbl_auth a on a.id = m.id where m.id = #{id}
